description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build and grow the server-side infrastructure that logs customer activity and supports invoicing. The work centers on data accuracy when records arrive delayed, reordered or repeated, on steady service response times across interactive and offline workloads, and on reporting screens that stay quick as stored history expands.
 What you'll do
 - Engineer counting logic so each usage record is captured one time despite delayed, reordered or duplicated inputs.
 - Tune service response times for both interactive calls and large offline workloads so neither degrades the other.
 - Verify that invoiced amounts line up with the usage actually logged for each account.
 - Improve the speed of usage dashboards as stored history grows larger.
 - Contribute to server-side infrastructure alongside the company's technical and executive leadership.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience.
 - Experience building and scaling core backend systems at an early-stage startup.
 - Track record of carrying server-side software from design through live operation, serving several million requests daily.
 - Hands-on experience with Python and a relational or cache data store.
 - Working knowledge of Next.js or React.
 Bonus points
 - Prior experience as a startup founder.
 - Experience with AI systems, payments integrations, or developer-facing APIs or SDKs.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 210,000 to 240,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
